subject: SIG: control mapping & evidence cadence - Aurum Technologies RFI
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@aurumtech.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/RFI: control mapping and evidence cadence request

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for taking the time on the initial call last week. Aurum is compiling responses for a SIG-based RFI and we have a couple of immediate asks so we can keep our procurement timeline intact: 1) a control-to-evidence crosswalk for SOC 2/ISO controls that maps Redwood artifacts to SIG control IDs; 2) a proposed cadence for delivering evidence (what you can deliver within 5 business days vs. longer lead items); and 3) confirmation of a SOC 2 report or SOC 2 summary we can share with our security team.

We aim to finalize vendor recommendations by 2027-06-15, so an internal walkthrough and a short artifact list from you by 2027-06-03 would be ideal. Can you propose a 45-minute slot for a control-walkthrough and indicate who on your side will own evidence collection?

Also tagging ProcureOps for any contractual questions (procureops@aurumtech.com).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to be flexible on times.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Director, Security & Compliance
Aurum Technologies
[Attachment: Aurum_RFI_Executive_Summary.docx (DOCX, 280KB)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@aurumtech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG/RFI: control mapping and evidence cadence request

Elena — thanks for the clear asks and the timeline.

Short answers up front: we have a SOC 2 Type II report from 2026 (summary attached) and can produce a control mapping workbook that aligns our artifacts to SIG controls. Marissa will own coordination for artifact collection; Karthik will lead the technical walkthrough and evidence verification.

Proposed next steps:
- 45-minute control-walkthrough: Wed 2027-06-02 at 09:30 PT or Thu 2027-06-03 at 11:00 PT (please confirm a preference)
- We will deliver an initial control-to-evidence crosswalk (spreadsheet) within 48 hours after the walkthrough for items that are available immediately.
- Items that require access requests or third-party attestations (e.g., cloud provider logs older than 90 days) will be flagged with expected lead times in the workbook.

Attachments I am sharing now: redwood-soc2-2026-summary.pdf (SOC 2 summary), redwood-control-map-2027.xlsx (template — internal draft).

If that works I’ll put a calendar invite on the preferred slot and Marissa will send a slim mutual action plan (MAP) with owners and deadlines.

Thanks — looking forward to the walkthrough.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-soc2-2026-summary.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]
[Attachment: redwood-control-map-2027.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Aurum RFI — artifact owners and quick list

Team — tagging you for a fast turnaround on Aurum’s requests. They expect the walkthrough tomorrow morning (09:30 PT) if Elena confirms; we should be prepared. Please see the items below and reply with owner + earliest delivery ETA.

Quick artifact ask (we should pre-stage these in Drive):
- SOC 2 Type II report (2026) — Marissa, confirm final PDF to share (sanitized redactions) — ETA within 1 business day
- Control mapping workbook: fill in evidentiary asset links and expected lead times — Marissa will own reactive updates; Ben to audit for traceability — ETA 48 hours post-walkthrough
- System architecture diagram + network segmentation note — Karthik to prepare an annotated diagram and 30-min demo during walkthrough — ETA: provide pre-read by EOD today
- Access/logs proof: Cloud provider config snapshots, retention policy, and sample audit logs — Ben to surface what’s shareable (we may need to request a collector job) — ETA: note in workbook

Also capture any third-party attestations (CDN, KMS) and mark TPF (third-party follow-up) items. Keep answers concise — procurement and security teams skim for mapping rows and SLA commitments.

Ben — can you sanity-check the redaction guidance in the SOC 2 summary before we send?
Marissa — if you want I can draft the MAP and invite the Aurum attendees once Elena confirms the slot.

Thanks,
Priyom

Priyom / team — thanks for the rapid reply and the draft attachments. Wed 2027-06-02 09:30 PT works for us — please send the calendar invite.

A few clarifications before the walkthrough:
- Can you flag any items in the control map that will require a signed DPA or an evidence access form? Our security team will not accept raw production logs without a formal request.
- For third-party attestations, please include the most recent date and issuer for each (e.g., GCP SOC 2 2025).
- Procurement note: we will attach a PO/Procurement form after the walkthrough if all looks good. Attached is our procurement cover form for your records.

We look forward to the walkthrough and the initial crosswalk after.
